description: This file defines a class HostedClient within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, implementing interfaces for grain context, lifecycle participation, and object management in a silo environment. The class manages message channels, lifecycle events, extension handling, and message processing for a hosted client within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: HostedClient
classes.description: A client hosted within an Orleans silo, responsible for message processing, extension management, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: CreateHostedClientGrainId
methods.description: Creates a ClientGrainId for a hosted client based on the silo address.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves or sets a grain extension, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: TryGetExtension
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a registered extension of a given type.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension, optionally registering a new one if absent.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, routing responses and scheduling requests.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the message pump task for processing incoming messages.

methods.name: RunClientMessagePump
methods.description: Asynchronous loop processing incoming message channels.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to lifecycle events for startup and shutdown.
